facts.fact: UNCTAD's tracker lists Décret exécutif n° 19-89 of 5 March 2019 as Algeria's electronic transactions legislation, fixing how registers of electronic commercial transactions are kept and sent to the national commerce register centre.
facts.system: Décret exécutif n° 19-89 fixant les modalités de conservation et de transmission des registres des transactions commerciales électroniques

note: The line does not name a parent law; its subject is online sellers' transaction registers. Law 18-05 line held as DZA-004.
